name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower | Strawberry Cough
description:
Bursting with sweet berry flavor and a spicy
exhale, Strawberry Cough is a sativa-dominant
cultivar known for its uplifting, clear-headed high
— often accompanied by a signature tickle in the
throat. Light, aromatic, and full of energy, it's the
strain of choice for creative focus and a
midday reset. Why It Belongs in Chronicles:
Chronicles captures the stories behind the strains
— and Strawberry Cough is a tale of joyful
resistance. Born from a mysterious clone and
famed for its giggly, get-up-and-go high, this
cultivar stands for flavor, nostalgia, and movement.
It's a chapter for those who breathe deep, smile
wide, and let inspiration take the lead.deep,
smile wide, and let inspiration take the lead.
